title: Endless Matrix
statementMd:
A Russian space traveller Alisa Selezneva, like any other schoolgirl of the late 21 century, is interested in science. She has recently visited the MIT (Moscow Institute of Time), where its chairman and the co-inventor of the time machine academician Petrov told her about the construction of a time machine.

During the demonstration of the time machine performance Alisa noticed that the machine does not have high speed and the girl got interested in the reason for such disadvantage. As it turns out on closer examination, one of the problems that should be solved for the time machine isn't solved by an optimal algorithm. If you find a way to solve this problem optimally, the time machine will run faster and use less energy.

A task that none of the staff can solve optimally is as follows. There exists a matrix $*a*$, which is filled by the following rule:

The cells are consecutive positive integers, starting with one. Besides, $*a*_{*i*, *j*} < *a*_{*t*, *k*}$ ($*i*, *j*, *t*, *k* ≥ 1$), if:

1. $*max*(*i*, *j*) < *max*(*t*, *k*)$;
2. $*max*(*i*, *j*) = *max*(*t*, *k*)$ and $*j* < *k*$;
3. $*max*(*i*, *j*) = *max*(*t*, *k*)$, $*j* = *k*$ and $*i* > *t*$.

So, after the first $36$ numbers are inserted, matrix $*a*$ will look as follows:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cca29592bac16980a108c120a83eb9fe7d77fcfd.png)

To solve the problem, you should learn to find rather quickly for the given values of $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}$ and $*y*_{2}$ ($*x*_{1} ≤ *x*_{2}, *y*_{1} ≤ *y*_{2}$) the meaning of expression:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/94c30c938cfe895f10e965c38eaded3f1a3707c0.png)

As the meaning of this expression can be large enough, it is sufficient to know only the last $10$ digits of the sought value.

So, no one in MTI can solve the given task. Alice was brave enough to use the time machine and travel the past to help you.

Your task is to write a program that uses the given values $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}$ and $*y*_{2}$ finds the last $10$ digits of the given expression.

## Input

The first input line contains a single integer $*t*$ ($1 ≤ *t* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of test sets for which you should solve the problem.

Each of the next $*t*$ lines contains the description of a test — four positive integers $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}$ and $*y*_{2}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{1} ≤ *x*_{2} ≤ 10^{9}, 1 ≤ *y*_{1} ≤ *y*_{2} ≤ 10^{9}$), separated by spaces.

## Output

For each query print the meaning of the expression if it contains at most $10$ characters. Otherwise, print three characters "`.`" (without the quotes), and then ten last digits of the time expression. Print the answer to each query on a single line. Follow the format, given in the sample as closely as possible.
statementZhMd:
俄罗斯太空旅行者阿丽莎·谢列兹涅娃和 21 世纪末的其他女学生一样，对科学很感兴趣。她最近参观了 MIT（莫斯科时间研究所），在那里，该研究所的主席、时间机器的共同发明者彼得罗夫院士向她介绍了时间机器的构造。

在演示时间机器的性能时，阿丽莎注意到机器的运行速度并不快，于是她对造成这一缺点的原因产生了兴趣。经过仔细检查后发现，时间机器需要解决的问题之一并没有使用最优算法解决。如果你能找到一种最优地解决这个问题的方法，时间机器将运行得更快，并且消耗更少的能量。

工作人员都无法最优解决的问题如下。存在一个矩阵 $*a*$，它按照以下规则填充：

单元格中填入从 1 开始的连续正整数。此外，当满足以下条件之一时，有 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} < *a*_{*t*, *k*}$（$*i*, *j*, *t*, *k* ≥ 1$）：

1. $*max*(*i*, *j*) < *max*(*t*, *k*)$；
2. $*max*(*i*, *j*) = *max*(*t*, *k*)$ 且 $*j* < *k*$；
3. $*max*(*i*, *j*) = *max*(*t*, *k*)$，$*j* = *k*$ 且 $*i* > *t*$。

因此，在填入前 $36$ 个数字后，矩阵 $*a*$ 将如下所示：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cca29592bac16980a108c120a83eb9fe7d77fcfd.png)

为了解决这个问题，你需要学会对于给定的 $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}$ 和 $*y*_{2}$（$*x*_{1} ≤ *x*_{2}, *y*_{1} ≤ *y*_{2}$），快速求出以下表达式的值：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/94c30c938cfe895f10e965c38eaded3f1a3707c0.png)

由于这个表达式的值可能很大，只需知道所求值的最后 $10$ 位即可。

因此，MTI 中没有人能够解决这个问题。阿丽莎鼓起勇气使用时间机器回到过去来帮助你。

你的任务是编写一个程序，利用给定的 $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}$ 和 $*y*_{2}$，求出给定表达式的最后 $10$ 位。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*t*$（$1 ≤ *t* ≤ 10^{5}$）——需要处理的测试数据组数。

接下来的 $*t*$ 行中，每行包含一组测试数据的描述——四个正整数 $*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}, *x*_{2}$ 和 $*y*_{2}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{1} ≤ *x*_{2} ≤ 10^{9}, 1 ≤ *y*_{1} ≤ *y*_{2} ≤ 10^{9}$），它们之间用空格分隔。

## 输出格式

对于每个询问，如果表达式的值至多包含 $10$ 位，则输出该值。否则，先输出三个字符 `.`（不含引号），然后输出该表达式值的最后十位数字。每个询问的答案输出一行。请尽可能严格按照样例中的格式输出。
